answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, and prove each bond with a cipher-based signature tying one deposit to one identity. A zephyr of cheap fake accounts cannot pass, because each new identity demands fresh locked capital that is slashed on fraud. At the summit of the market, influence scales with bonded stake, not account count, so an attacker must fund every Sybil — turning free identity farming into a costly, capital-intensive attack.
